session: daylight forward-heading offset re-derivation on deployed beta19 build 617337d3
method: Three isolated raw_pymammotion_execute_vector_segment drives (~0.45 m legs) at three headings. vio_motion_probe was REJECTED as the vehicle: it sends send_movement once and sleeps, with no motion_refresh_interval_ms, so the h-watchdog caps it near 0.10 m -- under motion_capture.py MIN_TRAVEL_FOR_BEARING = 0.20.

vision_to_map_offset.note: This is the offset turn_mode=vio actually uses, and the executor re-derives it per run from its own calibration drive (offset_source: calibration_drive).

toward_based_offset_102_4.verdict: UNMEASURABLE ON THIS HARDWARE -- not a lighting problem
toward_based_offset_102_4.evidence: toward was FROZEN across every forward leg: drive1 held 162.7649 across a 0.5351 m leg, drive2 held -85.9472 across a 0.6558 m leg. toward updates during TURNS and then freezes during forward travel.
toward_based_offset_102_4.implication: motion_capture.py --summarise computes implied = (bearing - toward_first) % 360. With toward stale, that is bearing minus an arbitrary constant, not a measurement. The 111.43/113.29/115.54 night values were computed this way and cannot support the ~11-degree-low claim.

structural_finding.claim: calibrated_forward_heading_offset_degrees (102.4) is NOT used for turn targeting in turn_mode=vio.
structural_finding.evidence: provided_offset_degrees reads the separate vio_heading_offset_degrees parameter (services.py:9533/9803); passing 102.4 left it null and offset_source was calibration_drive.
structural_finding.consequence: Gate 4 ran turn_mode=vio, so 102.4 was inert there and cannot explain its 4.70 cm cross-track miss.

measurement_chain_validation: Capture-derived travel bearing vs executor-computed bearing agreed to 0.14 deg (drive1) and 0.01 deg (drive2).
anomalies: drive3 turn ended stop_failed_aborting: RuntimeError BLE link is not ready for motion: command_queue_backlogged, on both the refresh and the stop. Safe abort by design; final_displacement_m 0.0; no linear phase ran.
drive3 durable record under-reports rotation: after_vision_heading is null because the poll failed, but the capture shows VIO 176.289 -> 149.571 (~27 deg) before the h-watchdog stopped the motors.
drive2 ended max_linear_commands_reached; drive3 ended turn_phase_incomplete. Neither affects the calibration offsets, which are taken before those phases.
teardown: experimental motion off, no session, blades zero, mower stationary at (4.7028, -2.6513), collectors stopped.
